reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it promotes an ordinary cashback-and-rewards process in which viewers sign up for CashKaro, shop through its retailer link, accumulate stated rewards, and convert them into an Amazon gift card. The video also advertises a separate monthly giveaway and asks viewers to like, comment, and subscribe, but the supplied evidence does not show a deceptive identity request, payment-for-access scheme, or recruitment-dependent earnings structure.
